title: fix(templates): inline review and publish fail when ClawHub handle has uppercase letters
body:
Closes #199405

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: inline Template review (`templates.drafts.review`) and publication (`templates.drafts.publish`) fail with `"Your ClawHub account needs a personal publisher handle."` (`clawhub_identity_required`) when ClawHub `/api/v1/whoami` returns a mixed-case GitHub OAuth `user.handle` (such as `MertBasar0`).

## User Impact

User impact: Control UI Template creators whose ClawHub / GitHub personal handle contains uppercase characters can now review and publish Templates inline under their canonical lowercase `@<handle>/<slug>` personal namespace without false `clawhub_identity_required` failures.

## Why This Change Was Made

ClawHub's `GET /api/v1/whoami` returns the GitHub-cased `user.handle` (for example `"MertBasar0"`), whereas ClawHub's publisher and package surfaces normalize personal handles to lowercase (`@mertbasar0/<slug>`, `ownerHandle: "mertbasar0"`, `https://clawhub.ai/mertbasar0/templates/<slug>`).

`personalPublisher` in `src/gateway/server-methods/templates-drafts.ts` is the sole `/api/v1/whoami` caller in `src/` (introduced in `f16e8bc092e7e`, carried through `d1c8d42588a4b` and `#196427`). Normalizing `result.user?.handle?.trim().toLowerCase()` at that producer boundary (net `0` production LOC: `+1/-1`) aligns review tokens, `prepareTemplateDraft`, upload `ownerHandle`, bound attempt status checks, and receipt URLs with ClawHub's canonical publisher handle.

## Evidence

### Live Windows Control UI Proof (Before vs After against live `https://clawhub.ai`)

**Before (`main` at `6001e95c4946`):** Clicking **Create template** in an isolated dev Gateway (`OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` + ephemeral port) with a ClawHub account whose `/api/v1/whoami` returns `"MertBasar0"` fails inline during `templates.drafts.review`:

![Before: Mixed-case ClawHub handle fails inline review](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8ad4ef06-0a2b-4418-a445-91ff8fe21fad)

**After (this PR):** The same live Control UI flow hydrates **Review your Template** (`by @mertbasar0`) cleanly and completes end-to-end live publication (`Unpublished` -> `Publishing…` -> `Pending` -> `Published` at `https://clawhub.ai/mertbasar0/templates/pr-review-radar`, ClawScan `verdict: "benign"`, `scanStatus: "clean"`):

![After: Inline review card hydrated for @mertbasar0/pr-review-radar](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/605b909f-70e9-4b39-a0bd-45065fb330ef)

![After: Live ClawHub publication completed in Control UI](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ec792831-9505-491a-ab1f-bed3cdf42801)

Live end-to-end Control UI recording (`recordVideo`, motion-trimmed):

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eb7217e3-e806-41b3-b702-7718828cfe8d

Redacted live Gateway WebSocket RPC trace:

```text
# Before (unpatched main 6001e95c4946)
templates.drafts.create -> durationMs=52 ok=true
templates.drafts.review -> durationMs=942 ok=false errorCode=INVALID_REQUEST errorMessage="Your ClawHub account needs a personal publisher handle."

# After (fix/templates-drafts-mixed-case-handle b761a69120a5)
templates.drafts.create -> durationMs=29 ok=true
templates.drafts.review -> durationMs=1418 ok=true
templates.drafts.publish -> durationMs=6929 ok=true publicationStatus=pending
templates.drafts.review(checkPublication=true) -> durationMs=4843 ok=true publicationStateStatus=published
```

### Tests & Checks

- Added boundary regression test `normalizes mixed-case and padded /whoami handles to lowercase personal publishers` in `src/gateway/server-methods/templates-drafts.test.ts` verifying mixed-case `/api/v1/whoami` handles (`"  MertBasar0  "`) normalize to `"mertbasar0"` across `templates.drafts.review`, `templates.drafts.publish` (`ownerHandle`), and bound attempt status polling:
  - Pre-fix run failed with `{"code":"INVALID_REQUEST","message":"Your ClawHub account needs a personal publisher handle."}`.
  - Post-fix run: `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-methods/templates-drafts.test.ts` -> `31 passed (31)`.
- Production vs test LOC delta (`git diff --numstat`): `src/gateway/server-methods/templates-drafts.ts` `+1/-1` (**net `0` production LOC**); `src/gateway/server-methods/templates-drafts.test.ts` `+36/-1`.
- Build & static checks:
  - `pnpm build` (exit 0)
  - `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/gateway/server-methods/templates-drafts.ts src/gateway/server-methods/templates-drafts.test.ts` (exit 0)
  - `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/gateway/server-methods/templates-drafts.ts src/gateway/server-methods/templates-drafts.test.ts` (`0 warnings and 0 errors`)
  - `pnpm tsgo:core` (exit 0)
- Local `$autoreview` (`codex`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `thinking=high`): `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported` (`0.99`).
